rows.proof: CAPITAL PROJECT FUNDS FY 2018, page 40 of the FY2018 annual town report -- 43 capital projects across six town-meeting programs, in three columns: APPROPRIATED FORWARD, EXPENDED/ENCUMBERED/TRANSFERRED and BALANCE, under a printed Grand Total. THE PAGE IS PRINTED SIDEWAYS AND ITS TEXT LAYER IS REVERSED: every word comes out of pdfplumber backwards and running top-to-bottom (`SDNUF TCEJORP LATIPAC` for CAPITAL PROJECT FUNDS), which is the FY2014 defect in this archive and the same remedy -- reverse each word and flip x, after which a table ROW is a constant mirrored x and a COLUMN is a constant y. No recognition was used; the characters are the ones in the file, and the rendered page was read as well to confirm the layout. WHAT PROVES IT: all three printed column totals tie EXACTLY -- APPROPRIATED FORWARD 9,328,231.68, EXPENDED/ENCUMBERED/TRANSFERRED 2,309,600.54 and BALANCE 7,018,631.14 -- and 43 of 43 rows close on appropriated_forward - expended = balance to the cent, which is 43 independent assertions on top of the three. ONE PROJECT PRINTS ON TWO LINES AND IS ONE ROW: `Development of Cemeteries` has its appropriation $84,200.00 on the line ABOVE its own label and its forward-from-FY17 ($612.96) on the label line, so the project's appropriated forward is 83,587.04, and 83,587.04 - 84,385.45 = (798.41), the balance the page prints. Reading those as two rows leaves one row with no balance and one whose identity misses by exactly 84,200.00. A `fwd` MARKER IS A LINE OF THE COLUMN, NOT AN ANNOTATION: the page's own legend says `fwd - forward from FY 17`, and on one row the text layer glues the marker to the figure as a single token, `($612.96)fwd`. FIVE PROJECTS CARRY A NEGATIVE EXPENDED FIGURE -- printed in parentheses, a transfer or rescission back to the project rather than a payment out of it -- and the exact Grand Total tie is what says that sign is read right.
